alertChannels.title: Notification channels
alertChannels.subtitle: Configure how you want to be notified - push (ntfy) and/or email. Choose when you're notified in "Triggers" just below.
alertChannels.ntfyHint: Leave blank to disable. Click "Generate" to create a URL with a random, unguessable identifier - on the public ntfy.sh server, that's what keeps anyone else from reading your notifications. Never invent a topic name yourself ("finalibaba-something") - anyone can guess it or stumble onto it. For privacy that doesn't depend on trusting ntfy.sh at all, self-host your own ntfy server - see "Self-hosted alerts" in the README to enable it as an optional service of this project.
alertChannels.ntfyAuthTokenHint: Only needed for a self-hosted ntfy server configured for private access - leave blank and unused with the public ntfy.sh server.
alertChannels.smtpPasswordHint: For Gmail or Outlook, use an app password (not your main account password) - they require one for third-party SMTP access.
alertChannels.smtpFromHint: For Gmail or Outlook, must match the SMTP user address, or the message gets rejected or rewritten. For the self-hosted mail server, leave user and password blank - trust comes from the internal Docker network, not credentials.
alertChannels.emailHint: Leave the address or SMTP host blank to disable email alerts.

projectionChart.title: Long-term projection
projectionChart.splitMethodology: Split based on your current allocation (investments + crypto vs. savings accounts only), applied in the same proportions to your future savings: this app doesn't know where your declared savings actually go. Checking accounts are deliberately not counted as "savings": many earn 0%, so their balance is held at today's value instead of compounding at the same rate as a savings account. The remaining balance (checking accounts, real estate, vehicles, minus any loans not already attached to them) is held at today's value, with no growth assumption.
projectionChart.noContributionNote: No declared monthly savings: projection reflects current net worth growth only
